description.zh:
启动偏移。视频文件起始偏移值。仅对文件视频有效， 单位：毫秒。

大于0，表示从相对于首帧的偏差时间作为开始读取的位置。
description.en:
The start offset for the video file. This parameter is valid only for video files. Unit: milliseconds.

A value greater than 0 specifies the start time relative to the first frame.

description.zh: 节目单ID。如果您通过[AddPlaylistItems接口](~~2848078~~)添加节目单项，请查看AddPlaylistItems接口调用返回的参数ProgramId值。
description.en: The ID of the playlist. If you add items to the playlist by calling the [AddPlaylistItems](~~2848078~~) operation, use the value of the ProgramId parameter that is returned.

description.zh:
重启模式。取值：
- **Restart**：从头开始。
- **Continue**：根据停止前播放位置继续。如果**ResumeMode**参数设置为**Custom**时，请求参数**StartItemId**才必填。
- **Custom**：自定义。
description.en:
The restart mode. Valid values:

- **Restart**: Starts from the beginning.

- **Continue**: Resumes playback from where it was stopped. The **StartItemId** parameter is required only when you set the **ResumeMode** parameter to **Custom**.

- **Custom**: Custom start point.

description.zh:
起始节目单项ID。启动轮播时将先播放此节目单项。
><notice> 如果**ResumeMode**参数设置为**Custom**时，此参数才必传。
></notice>
description.en:
The ID of the item to play first. When the carousel starts, this item is played.

><notice>

This parameter is required only when you set **ResumeMode** to **Custom**.

></notice>

descriptions.zh:
先通过[AddPlaylistItems接口](~~2848078~~)添加节目单项，再调用本接口启动整个节目单。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Call the [AddPlaylistItems](~~2848078~~) operation to add items to a playlist. Then, call this operation to start the playlist.

## QPS limit

This operation has a queries per second (QPS) limit of 10 for each user. If you exceed this limit, your API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation within the specified limit.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live start-playlist --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --program-id 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --resume-mode Custom --start-item-id asdfasdfasdf0000 --offset 10000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live StartPlaylist --region cn-hangzhou --StartItemId asdfasdfasdf0000 --ResumeMode Custom --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ProgramId '445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000' --Offset 10000
